events.title: The Chair by the Window
lines: Rin|You moved the chair again.
You|The morning light reaches this corner.
Rin|So does the draft. I can choose where I sit, you know.
You|Then where would you like it?
Rin|Beside yours. Just for breakfast.
Narrator|It is a small answer, but you finally hear the question beneath it.

choices.text: Then beside mine it stays.
I will fetch a blanket too.

events.title: The Crisp Edges
lines: Rin|You always leave the darkest piece of bread for yourself.
You|I thought you liked the soft middle.
Rin|I like the crisp edges. You never asked.
You|Then we have eight years of breakfasts to correct.
Rin|Start with this one.
Narrator|She breaks the toast in two and gives you the larger half.

choices.text: Remember her preference.
Ask her to teach you her recipe.

events.title: A Map Folded Twice
lines: Rin|This atlas is older than we are.
You|Most of the roads are probably gone.
Rin|That does not mean the places are. Look: a town where the lanterns float on the river.
You|Would you like to see it?
Rin|I would like to be asked when we are not talking about medicine.
Narrator|You leave a ribbon between the pages.

choices.text: We can want something beyond a cure.
Tell me about another place.

events.title: Rain on the Windowsill
lines: Rin|The rosemary is leaning toward the glass.
You|I could move it outside.
Rin|Not yet. It needs to learn the weather a little at a time.
You|You sound like the gardener your father used to call you.
Rin|I would rather be the gardener I might become.
Narrator|Together, you turn the pot toward the light.

choices.text: Then let us plan your garden.
You already know more than I do.

events.title: An Honest Return
lines: Rin|Did you get hurt today?
You|Only a scratch.
Rin|You say that before you even look at the bandage.
You|I thought worrying you would make things harder.
Rin|Guessing is harder. Let me know the person who comes home.
Narrator|You set your pack down between you instead of hiding it by the door.

choices.text: Tell her what happened.
Promise to bring difficult news home too.

events.title: A Game Without Winners
lines: Rin|You are letting me win.
You|I am considering my strategy.
Rin|Your strategy has lost four pieces in a row.
You|Perhaps I like your victorious expression.
Rin|Then earn it honestly.
Narrator|Her laugh interrupts the rain. For a while, neither of you listens for anything else.

choices.text: Play properly, and stay for another round.
Ask for a lesson.

events.title: Letters in the Margin
lines: Rin|The forester wrote the symptoms in reverse order.
You|The healer said that page was useless.
Rin|He read the list. He did not read the dates.
You|You think the moss treats the fever, not the cause.
Rin|I think we should find out together.
Narrator|For the first time, her handwriting joins yours in the treatment book.

choices.text: Make Rin a partner in the research.
Ask her to explain every step.

events.title: The Mended Sleeve
lines: Rin|Hold still. The thread keeps catching.
You|You do not have to mend my coat.
Rin|And you do not have to carry every difficult thing yourself.
You|That is not quite the same.
Rin|No. But it is where I can start.
Narrator|The repaired seam is crooked and stronger than it was.

choices.text: Thank her without arguing.
Offer to repair her old chair next.

events.title: The Long Way to the Well
lines: Rin|Do not slow down before I ask.
You|I was watching the road.
Rin|You were watching me.
You|Is that so terrible?
Rin|Only if it means you miss the flowers.
Narrator|At the well she rests, and tells you which seeds she wants to plant.

choices.text: Ask her to choose the route next time.
Sit and watch the village together.

events.title: Two Cups Cooling
lines: Rin|If they find the cure, will you still sit here?
You|Of course.
Rin|You answered very quickly.
You|I have had years to think about this chair.
Rin|I meant with me.
Narrator|The steam has faded. Neither of you reaches for the cups.

choices.text: I want the ordinary days with you.
You will never have to earn my company.

events.title: A River of Paper Lanterns
lines: Rin|I tried drawing that river town.
You|The lanterns look like stars.
Rin|They are supposed to. You write a wish on the paper first.
You|What would yours say?
Rin|Ask me when we get there.
Narrator|She folds the drawing small enough to fit in your coat pocket.

choices.text: Keep the drawing and promise a journey.
Tell her your own wish.

events.title: A Seat at the Table
lines: Rin|Let me stir.
You|The pot is heavy.
Rin|Then hold the handle. I can still stir.
You|We make a convincing kitchen team.
Rin|A team requires you to listen sometimes.
Narrator|You hold the handle. She seasons the soup. Dinner tastes like both of you.

choices.text: Let her lead the cooking.
Write down the recipe together.

events.title: The Name of the Illness
lines: Rin|The physician called it a failure of the body.
You|There may have been no better name.
Rin|There should have been. I have spent years hearing that I am failing.
You|You have survived every one of those years.
Rin|Then write that down too.
Narrator|You turn the page and leave room for a better account.

choices.text: Ask Rin to name the research journal.
Write: a person, never a diagnosis.

events.title: The Empty Place
lines: Rin|I miss my father most when something good happens.
You|I still remember what I promised him.
Rin|I know. But I did not ask you to spend your life repaying a dead man.
You|I am not here only because of him.
Rin|Then someday, tell me why you stayed.
Narrator|Her hand rests near yours, close enough to choose.

choices.text: Take her hand and tell her you love her.
Tell her she is your closest friend.

events.title: Seeds for Next Year
lines: Rin|I ordered seeds that will not flower until next year.
You|That sounds optimistic.
Rin|It sounds like a decision.
You|Where will you put them?
Rin|At the village greenhouse. I asked about helping there.
Narrator|The future arrives as a paper packet on the table.

choices.text: Support the greenhouse she chose.
Offer help when she asks for it.

events.title: An Unfinished Constellation
lines: Rin|You connected the wrong stars.
You|I was making a new constellation.
Rin|What is it called?
You|The Road We Have Not Taken.
Rin|Then leave it unfinished. We might find more stars later.
Narrator|She leans against you, warm beneath the evening shawl.

choices.text: Ask her to travel with you after treatment.
Stay until she is ready to go inside.

events.title: What Courage Looks Like
lines: Rin|The hero in this game never stops to eat.
You|Perhaps that is why he keeps losing.
Rin|Perhaps someone should tell him that coming home is an achievement.
You|Is that your professional advice?
Rin|Yes. From an expert in waiting.
Narrator|You set the pieces aside before the candles burn low.

choices.text: Promise time together even during the final search.
Ask how waiting has felt for her.

events.title: No More Brave Faces
lines: Rin|I am afraid the treatment will not work.
You|So am I.
Rin|You are allowed to say that?
You|I am learning.
Rin|Then I am afraid, and I am hopeful. Both can stay.
Narrator|You sit with the uncertainty until it becomes something you can carry together.

choices.text: Face the uncertainty together.
Ask what would make tomorrow easier.

events.title: Her Answer
lines: Rin|I have read every version of the formula.
You|And?
Rin|I want to try. Not because you promised. Because I want a life after this.
You|Tell me what you need.
Rin|The truth, someone beside me, and the right to change my mind.
Narrator|You place the final page in front of her. She signs her own name.

choices.text: Respect her treatment decision.
Promise to listen at every step.

events.title: A Door Without a Debt
lines: Rin|The latch finally opens without a fight.
You|It only took us eight years.
Rin|Some things take practice.
You|Is this still about the door?
Rin|I want to stay because I choose to. I want you to know that.
Narrator|The repaired door stands open to the spring air.

choices.text: Tell her you choose her too.
Tell her this will always be her home.

events.title: A Small Celebration
lines: Rin|What are we celebrating?
You|We made it through another week.
Rin|That is enough?
You|It should have been enough sooner.
Rin|Then give me the crisp piece.
Narrator|There are no guests, no speeches, and more than enough reasons to set two places.

choices.text: Celebrate the life you already share.
Ask her to name the next occasion.

events.title: The Shape of Tomorrow
lines: Rin|When I can walk farther, I will still want to stop here.
You|At the old well?
Rin|At a place we reached slowly.
You|We can come back as often as you like.
Rin|And leave as often as I like.
Narrator|You realize that both promises matter.

choices.text: Make room for both staying and leaving.
Ask where she wants to go first.

events.title: Not an Obligation
lines: Rin|If we call this love, it must be ours.
You|It is.
Rin|Not an illness. Not your promise. Not gratitude for being looked after.
You|I love your impossible questions and your terrible board-game victories.
Rin|Good. Those will survive a cure.
Narrator|She takes your hand before asking the question.

choices.text: Ask to build a life together, as equals.
Keep the closeness you have as friends.

events.title: Before the Morning
lines: Rin|Tomorrow feels very close.
You|We do not have to solve it tonight.
Rin|I know. Tonight, tell me something ordinary.
You|The rosemary needs a larger pot.
Rin|Then that is our first plan.
Narrator|Beyond the window, the road waits. Inside, there is still time for one more cup of tea.

choices.text: Stay, and make one ordinary plan.
Share the wish you have been carrying.
